name: load a remote dataset with a specific configuration
definition: Fetch the dataset from its hub page with the correct config identifier and reserved split, following the dataset README to know which config and fields to read.
failure_mode: Loading the wrong dict/config or missing fields yields a wrong total.

name: locate encoded files by their naming convention
definition: Identify the files in a directory that carry the obfuscation suffix, using any accompanying hint note, without touching unrelated content.
failure_mode: Scanning a wrong file set recovers the wrong results or misses files.
